title: Penguin Solutions Full-Stack AI Factory Platform Enables Lektra's Distributed AI Data Centers
summary: Collaboration simplifies development of pioneering distributed cloud network powered entirely by existing carbon-free energy and designed to distribute AI infrastructure geographically Penguin Solutions , Inc. (Nasdaq: PENG ), the AI Factory Platform Company that designs, builds, and manages next generation AI data center infrastructure worldwide, today announced that it has been selected by Lektra to deploy and optimize their AI micro data centers. Penguin Solutions will provide validated reference designs, AI-optimized compute, and expert-led services and support needed to deliver and scale Lektra distributed EdgeScale™ AI data centers. Penguin Solutions is collaborating with Lektra to deploy and optimize distributed AI data centers powered by its Full-Stack AI Factory Platform. Shown here on a metropolitan rooftop, a Lektra EdgeScale micro data center leverages local carbon-free energy to help overcome centralized grid constraints. Penguin Solutions is the AI Factory Platform Company. We design, build, and manage next-generation data centers for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers.


With deep design expertise at the intersection of data center AI infrastructure and memory solutions, our Full-Stack AI Factory Platform combines differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner technologies to help customers accelerate deployment, optimize token economics, and maximize the return on their AI investments.
